item.title: Inside Syria’s women-led revolution
item.description: TRNN was granted rare access to a YPJ commander at a hidden base in northeast Syria, offering a ground-level view of a women’s revolution as Rojava was preparing for war.

item.title: US military helping Trump to build massive network of ‘concentration camps,’ Navy contract reveals
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is using a repurposed $55 billion Navy contract to convert warehouses into makeshift jails and plan sprawling tent cities in remote areas.

item.title: Biden, Trump, the media, the public—we have all failed the residents of East Palestine, OH
item.description: “I'm pissed at how many people have forgotten about what happened here. I'm pissed that everybody thinks we're doing fine, that everything in East Palestine, OH, is good. It's not.”

item.title: US media rushes to defend police departments from liberal backlash against ICE
item.description: Appealing to imagined reforms, center-left media tastemakers assure their audiences DHS violence exists outside the otherwise progressive status quo.

item.title: Bannon calls for ICE to engage in voter intimidation during the midterms
item.description: “You’re damn right we’re gonna have ICE surround the polls come November,” former Trump strategist Steve Bannon said.

item.title: Israel’s US-backed assault on Gaza set stage for collective punishment in Cuba, AOC says
item.description: “This is a new kind of era of depravity opened up,” said the congresswoman. “There was this stated commitment on human rights—that innocent civilians were almost exempt from the rules of war, from blockades.”

item.title: Inside the right-wing movement pushing Alberta to secede from Canada
item.description: Trump officials have repeatedly met with secessionist leaders from the province, which has large oil and gas deposits.

item.title: Israel just started legalizing its annexation of the West Bank. Here’s what that means.
item.description: The Israeli government recently took radical steps to change the legal status quo in the West Bank. Here’s what these changes mean and how they set the stage for annexation.

item.title: Trump orders Defense, Energy Departments to reinvest in coal
item.description: One study showed that coal power plants led to nearly half a million U.S. deaths over a 20-year period.

item.title: Republicans approve ‘dystopian’ voter suppression bill that would force states to give info to DHS
